test_title: PYST 35: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

______ food consumption can affect our bodies’ immune systems.
solution:
The correct answer is: "**Unhygienic**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• "**Unhygienic**" means not clean or not sanitary. (साफ-सुथरा नहीं या मैली)
 
• The sentence is saying that consuming unhygienic food can affect our immune systems.
 
• The grammatical structure is "**adjective + noun**".
 
• The opposite of "unhygienic" would be "hygienic", which means clean and sanitary.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

**Complete sentence**: *Unhygienic __food consumption can affect our bodies’ immune systems. *

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• "**Nutritious**", means healthy and beneficial for the body. (पौष्टिक)
 
• "**Sanitary**", means clean and free from germs. (सफ़ाई का)
 
• "**Unwise**", means not smart or not sensible. (बेवक़ूफ़)
